title: A Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Multi-Stream Quickest Change Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.20876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework is proposed for quickest change detection (QCD) where there are multiple experts, and each expert produces a sequence of statistics for change detection. A change is declared when a weighted sum of these statistics crosses a threshold. This framework is then applied to the problem of multi-stream QCD to obtain a family of powerful algorithms that outperform the best known algorithms in the literature. In the multi-stream QCD problem, a decision-maker observes multiple streams of observations. At the change point, the distribution of an unknown subset of the streams changes. The optimal algorithm based on a generalized likelihood ratio is computationally expensive. One of the most computationally and performance-efficient algorithms in the literature is the rank-weighted sum (RWS) scheme based on Shiryaev-Roberts statistics. translated_title: 面向多流最快变化检测的专家混合框架
translated_abstract: 提出了一种用于最快变化检测（QCD）的专家混合框架，其中包含多个专家，每个专家生成一系列用于变化检测的统计量。当这些统计量的加权和超过阈值时，即宣告检测到一次变化。随后，将该框架应用于多流最快变化检测问题，得到了一系列性能强大的算法，其表现优于文献中已知的最优算法。在多流最快变化检测问题中，决策者观察多个观测流，在变化点处，未知子集的流的分布会发生改变。基于广义似然比的最优算法计算代价高昂，而文献中在计算和性能上效率最高的算法之一是基于Shiryaev-Roberts统计量的秩加权和（RWS）方案。论文中证明了基于专家混合的多流QCD算法……
tldr: 本文提出了一种用于最快变化检测的专家混合框架，并将其应用于多流变化检测问题，所得到的算法在性能上优于文献中已知的最优算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Mixture-of-Experts framework for quickest change detection, which, when applied to the multi-stream setting, yields powerful algorithms that outperform the best known algorithms in the literature.
